hypothesis.statement: For the frozen left-associated five-source RCB circuit and fixed registry, exact TT cores for the five nonzero trace-zero first-norm source tensors can be constructed gate by gate without enumerating B^5 input tuples; after charged fixed-curve preprocessing, exact target specialization is obtained by one five-term TT linear combination and exact recompression.
hypothesis.mechanism: Each coordinate of each source mode is a rank-one mode-local TT. TT direct sums implement addition. A streamed Hadamard routine reshapes its prefix transfer as (s,la,lb), contracts first with the A slice and then the B slice, and never materializes the raw Kronecker train. A left-to-right then right-to-left exact finite-field rank-factorization normalizer removes redundant bonds after every circuit gate. Executing the literal four RCB additions yields exact coordinate TTs X,Y,Z. Five further exact products yield X^2, XZ, Z^2, YZ, and Y^2; the corrected target coefficients then specialize h_Q.
assumptions: The frozen C08, C10, and C12 curves, registries, targets, mode order, left-associated tree, and literal RCB gate text are inherited without change from EXP-ECDLP-TT-NORM-RANK-001/instance-manifest-v1.json.
Each primary registry contains B distinct affine F_p points represented projectively with Z=1.
A TT core has shape (r_{j-1},B,r_j), with boundary ranks one, and denotes the exact contraction of its five cores over F_p.

Exact recompression first makes prefix interfaces full column rank with a left-to-right factorization sweep, then makes suffix interfaces full row rank with a right-to-left sweep; no numerical approximation is used.

The streamed Hadamard routine materializes at most one declared local factorization matrix and transfer matrix at a time, not the full B^5 tensor or a raw five-core product with both uncompressed neighboring bonds.

The producer is restricted to the hashed source closure, file-read and dense-kernel allowlists, at most three-dimensional arrays, NumPy 2.4.0 signed int64 C-order kernels with explicit canonical-range and no-overflow checks, and no dynamic code, child process, network, predecessor artifact, or verifier access.

Online complexity claims remain conditional on source ranks and normalization constants staying independent of B beyond the toy registry range; the experiment measures actual toy work and does not establish that asymptotic premise.

predictions.metric: independent source and target semantic mismatch count
producer TT bond dimensions versus independent unfolding ranks
predictions.minimum_effect: all four bonds equal the independently computed exact ranks for every emitted nonzero tensor

predictions.metric: retained five-source advice and target-specialization accounting
predictions.minimum_effect: all core words, field operations, logical traffic, canonical bytes, and peak live state are emitted separately from verifier enumeration
either every mandatory cell completes below budget or one exact gate, operation, mode, matrix shape, and stopping boundary is preserved

parameters.recompression_schedule: complete left-then-right normalization after every TT addition, subtraction, and Hadamard product; certified rank preservation for nonzero scalar multiplication; tagged canonical zero for scalar zero

test_boundary.implementation: A capability-restricted producer uses exact NumPy int64 two-stage contractions and finite-field row reduction to compile TTs from mode-local vectors and the literal RCB circuit, emits allocation/free events and a complete C08 primitive transcript, and evaluates only frozen O(1) sample tuples. A non-importing standard-library verifier uses separate TT evaluation and rank code, independently transcribed EC arithmetic, exhaustive B^5 replay, and arbitrary-precision integer controls.

falsification_conditions: The producer enters a five-mode Cartesian enumeration path, reads a prior B^5 source table, or derives any core from exhaustive tuple values.
Any independently replayed source tensor or target-specialized h_Q value differs from direct frozen RCB evaluation.
Any emitted nonzero TT bond exceeds or falls below the independently computed exact unfolding rank after the producer claims exact recompression.
Any mandatory raw bond, factorization, transfer, retained advice, field-operation, traffic, canonical-byte, or peak-state term is absent or undercounted.
Any mandatory cell requires more than 2 GiB RSS or a factorization matrix above 1000000 field words under the literal gatewise schedule.
The independent verifier cannot reject a registered circuit, core, mode-order, transfer, target-coefficient, accounting, provenance, or hidden-enumeration mutation.
The producer violates the capability, dtype, canonical-range, overflow, immediate-reduction, allocation-event, cumulative-counter, or artifact gate.
interpretation_limits: Passing is TOY-EVIDENCE for one constructive first-norm source-advice path and a RESTRICTED IMPLEMENTATION RESULT for the frozen circuit schedule.

Failure is a NEGATIVE RESULT only for the literal gate order, mode order, exact factorization routine, and mandatory sizes; it does not reject all TT, coefficient-space, reordered-contraction, or common-Hilbert-basis compilers.
The verifier's B^5 replay is a semantic oracle and cannot be reclassified as preprocessing or online work.
Avoiding B^5 tuple enumeration does not imply less toy work or memory: legitimate bond-space objects exceed one scalar B^5 table at B=5 and are compared explicitly.
No fitted exponent below 0.5, relation probability, matrix yield, witness localization, target descent, or ECDLP improvement follows from this experiment.
The h_Q^(p-1) Fermat indicator and all later locator stages remain OPEN even if every source tensor compiles.
